summary: Iteration 149 - Frontend-only testing of Manufacturing Dashboard UX improvements. All 3 features verified successfully: (1) Delay badge at FG level only - confirmed delay badges only appear on FG MOs (parent_wo_id is null) and not on child MOs, delay calculated from scheduled_end only, correctly suppressed for completed/cancelled status. (2) Cancelled MO badge in solid red - verified bg=#9B1C1C (rgb(155,28,28)) with white text and font-weight 500 (semibold). (3) Cancelled MO stat card + clickable filter cards - all 4 cards present (Total/Under Process/Finished/Cancelled), toggle behavior works correctly, active card shows solid color bg + white text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 149 verified 3 frontend UX improvements on Manufacturing page: (1) Delay badge logic - only shows on FG MOs (parent_wo_id is null) when scheduled_end < today AND status not in completed/cancelled. Tested with MO-000001 which has past date but cancelled status - correctly no delay badge. (2) Cancelled status badge - solid red bg (#9B1C1C = rgb(155,28,28)) with white text and font-semibold. Verified via computed styles on 127 cancelled badges. (3) Stat cards - 4 clickable cards (Total: 532, Under Process: 341, Finished: 27, Cancelled: 85) with toggle filter behavior. Active card shows solid color bg + white text + ring. data-testids: stat-card-total, stat-card-under-process, stat-card-finished, stat-card-cancelled.
